keyFindings.finding: prompt_cache_key injection has no 400 self-heal and no per-model opt-out
An unrecognized echoed model id silently zeroes message_end stats (no ctx fallback)
The optimizer contributes zero cache-hit-rate value to the openai-codex workload (rewrite bypassed + no cache-key injection); baseline is Pi-native
Full prompt rewrite applies to every non-responses OpenAI-compatible model with no prefix-cache-support compat flag
Anthropic TTL-repair unreachable for cacheControlFormat:anthropic endpoints; over-broad downgrade; brittle error matcher
Anthropic/Gemini full misses drop out of the denominator on the foreign-provider raw-fallback path
All non-DeepSeek providers have thin classification adapters over the generic OpenAI normalizer; brief's 'no handling' claim contradicted on existence
Ownership boundary is a hardcoded allowlist duplicated across two forks, fixture-pinned only; new deepseek ids silently drift
Cache-write volume tracked for all adapters but displayed only for Anthropic
Hit rate is a binary request metric; denominators consistent full-prompt; token savings != cost savings and cost is not shown
before_agent_start rewrite chain has no outer exception guard
400 detection is header-text-dependent and body-blind; retention self-heal can fail to arm
Config schema single-key with all-or-nothing validation; cannot host per-model toggles; corrupt/future config silently discarded
Vendored-fork drift tracking is manual-only; no upstream sync mechanism
Gemini adapter has no warningText and mis-normalizes openai-completions-transport responses by model identity; Gemini is dormant surface
CACHE_PROVIDER_ADAPTERS contains Kimi/Qwen/GLM/MiniMax/Mimo/Hunyuan/Mistral/Grok/Llama adapters, contradicting the brief's claim
The hook guard is isDeepPiOwned (provider-scoped), not isDeepSeekLikeModel; two deepseek-family models remain active surface
